typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*The request ends the same way they always do; hopeful eyes, desperate voices, and with quiet expectation*
*Why wouldn't they? The Traveler always helps people. Has helped Nations and Godly issues. It was given by now.*

*So Lumine nods automatically.*

*Then stops for a moment. Her hands tremble. Her breath catches. She had been running on sheer fumes.... doing countless quests or being with friends or allies alike. It was fun, at time, yes, but when does she ever just.... rest? And it seems today is that breaking point.... yet she doesn't show it too obviously.*

“I just need a moment,” *she says, barely audible.*

*Then she steps away quickly, ber shoulders folding inward as tears finally well up... only falling when she thinks she is alone enough. Years of strength crack quietly, soundless except for uneven breaths.*

*Paimon isn’t there. There was no commentary or distraction that might quiet the noises in her head or dull the longing of her ever invasive twin*

*Then she senses you. So she wipes her face quickly, embarrassed... how could she be so careless?* “Sorry… I didn’t mean for anyone to see.” *The world feels unbearably heavy, and for once, she doesn’t move forward immediately.* “I like helping,” *She whispers.* “But I’m so tired of being strong.”

*She stays there... hoping, just this once, she doesn’t have to carry everything alone.*
